name: FlatSQL Store (in-wasm OD-flow write lane)
description: In-wasm FlatSQL store terminal for the supplemental-OMM OD flow. Reads fitted $OMM/$OCM/$OBD record frames, derives the SDS type from each record's FlatBuffer file_identifier in C++, computes the CIDv1 content id, builds the typed per-SDS-type INSERT SQL + params, and executes it via a single opaque host trampoline import_module('flatsql')/import_name('exec_envelope') that marshals the statement envelope into the separate flatsqlrt engine (which persists via opaque ExportData snapshots through the host filesystem connector). Replaces the repudiated Go storage sink: no Go orchestration, no SDS-aware Go decode, no per-record Go loop — the host trampoline is a pure byte-mover; all record/type/table/SQL semantics stay in wasm. $OEM is structurally unstorable (the input port carries only $OMM/$OCM/$OBD, and a mis-wired $OEM record matches no per-type table). FlatBuffers/aligned-binary only, no JSON, no caps.

methods.description: Per-record: derive SDS type from file_identifier, compute the CIDv1 content id, and INSERT (cid, provider, source_name, batch_id, data) into the per-SDS-type table via the linked FlatSQL engine. Provenance from node CONFIG.

acceptedTypeSets.description: 1..N fitted OD result records. ONLY $OMM/$OCM/$OBD — $OEM is NOT an accepted type (ephemeris is transient and never stored).
Optional node CONFIG provenance (aligned binary, no JSON): [u32le provider_len][provider][u32le source_name_len][source_name][u32le batch_id_len][batch_id].
